details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a net outflow of $226 million on July 24, ending a seven-day streak of inflows. In contrast, Ethereum ETFs experienced a net inflow of $23.32 million on the same day, indicating a divergence in institutional investor interest between the two major crypto assets.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $226M Outflow; Ether ETFs Gain

details: The World Foundation, the non-profit behind Worldcoin, successfully raised $52.5 million through a strategic WLD token sale. Led by Pantera Capital, with all purchased tokens subject to a one-year lockup, the funding aims to expand the World ID "proof-of-human" infrastructure. This initiative is designed to address the increasing demand for human verification in an online environment heavily influenced by AI.
title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M for World ID Amid AI Growth

details: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon has publicly endorsed the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, advocating for market stability and clear regulatory frameworks for digital assets. This support comes as Galaxy Research lowered the bill's passage probability for 2026 to 30%, citing ongoing legislative deadlock and a constrained Senate schedule before the August recess.
title: Goldman Sachs CEO Backs CLARITY Act Amid Legislative Hurdles
